description:
"Surround yourself with solar rays, applying Minor Maim to nearby enemies for |cffffff10|r seconds, reducing their damage done by |cffffff5|r%.

You gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff6802|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds, increasing by |cffffff10|r% for each enemy hit, up to |cffffff60|r%. This ability scales off your Max Health.

When the shield expires it explodes, dealing |cffffff37|r% of damage absorbed as Magic Damage to nearby enemies."
